content.value_statement: Paid advertising accounts lose efficiency when campaign types, targeting, and intent groups overlap. This skill designs a clear structure with exclusions and audience scoring.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Search, Performance Max, or broad match based on campaign goals, intent maturity, and available assets.
Maps ad groups or asset groups around one intent theme to reduce internal competition.
Defines keyword match types, audience signals, placement exclusions, and targeting rules.
Builds negative keyword and cross-campaign exclusion plans from search-term evidence.
Compares paid query themes with organic traffic data to identify possible cannibalization.
Scores the ROAS Audience dimension and marks missing placement evidence as NEEDS_INPUT.
limitations: Does not calculate the final RQS or enforce every ROAS veto.
Does not allocate campaign budgets or calculate spend splits.
Depends on user-provided exports, campaign goals, themes, and current account information.
Produces a plan and handoff, but does not publish changes to advertising platforms.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Account
use_cases.description: Choose campaign types and create intent-based groups before launching a paid advertising account.

use_cases.title: Restructure Existing Campaigns
use_cases.description: Use campaign and search-term exports to reduce overlap and improve exclusions.

use_cases.title: Review Channel Cannibalization
use_cases.description: Compare paid query themes with organic traffic to identify low-incremental-value spending.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a paid campaign structure for [goal] on [platform]. Use [themes] and explain the recommended campaign type.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure an Account
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign and search-terms export: [data]. Propose intent-based groups, match types, negative keywords, and exclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Channel Overlap
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this campaign export with this GA4 traffic-acquisition export: [data]. Identify paid and organic overlap and recommend actions.

prompt_templates.title: Score and Prepare Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [profile], score ROAS Audience and structure from these exports: [data]. Mark missing evidence NEEDS_INPUT and prepare an auditor handoff.

output_examples.input: Goal: capture high-intent demand for enterprise payroll software on Google Ads.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: Use Search campaigns grouped by payroll migration, compliance, and enterprise integration intent. Keep brand terms separate and add cross-campaign negatives.

output_examples.input: The search-terms report shows overlapping broad and exact keywords across three campaigns.
output_examples.output: Structure finding: Consolidate each intent theme under one owner campaign. Add cross-campaign negatives and preserve exact terms where tighter control is required.

output_examples.input: Campaign and GA4 exports show paid clicks on several strong organic brand queries.
output_examples.output: Cannibalization finding: Test reduced brand coverage for stable top-ranking queries. Retain paid coverage for competitors, promotions, and weak organic positions.

best_practices: Provide current campaign, search-term, placement, and GA4 exports when available.
State the campaign goal, platform, profile, target themes, and available creative or feed assets.
Review the proposed structure before allowing the skill to save its final report.
anti_patterns: Do not ask this skill to calculate the final RQS or all ROAS vetoes.
Do not use it for budget allocation or spend optimization.
Do not treat missing placement evidence as a passing brand-safety result.

faq.question: Which campaign types can this skill compare?
faq.answer: It compares Search, Performance Max, and broad-match approaches using goals, intent maturity, creative readiness, and feed readiness.

faq.question: Can it build negative keyword lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It derives negatives from search terms and proposes cross-campaign negatives to reduce internal overlap.

faq.question: Does it calculate campaign budgets?
faq.answer: No. Budget allocation belongs to the separate budget optimizer workflow.

faq.question: Can it audit paid and organic cannibalization?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares paid query themes with GA4 traffic data and flags areas with limited incremental value.

faq.question: Does it change campaigns inside advertising platforms?
faq.answer: No. It produces a structure plan, exclusions, scores, and a handoff for review.

faq.question: What happens when required evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks unsupported checks as NEEDS_INPUT instead of assigning a passing result.
